predictions.prediction_text: Vol grind up through the month is expected.
predictions.expected_result: Implied and/or realized volatility will trend higher over the remainder of the month compared with current levels (measurable as a positive change in VIX or realized vol over the month).

predictions.prediction_text: VIX expo impact on Tuesday will reflexively influence the SPX spot and reshape its vol environment.
predictions.expected_result: SPX spot and its option-implied volatilities will show a measurable move (directional change and/or increased vol term-structure/IV levels) during Tuesday's session relative to the prior session.

predictions.prediction_text: This creates a pin (price magnet) at the centroid of the gamma convexity.
predictions.expected_result: SPX price will gravitate toward and trade around the centroid gamma level, with reduced directional excursions (higher time spent near that price) until centroid is broken.

predictions.prediction_text: Gamma pinning at the centroid will suppress volatility and create a mean-reverting loop, preventing momentum from escaping without high vol.
predictions.condition: price is at or near the centroid of the gamma convexity
predictions.expected_result: SPX realized volatility will fall and price movements will show mean-reversion (reduced intraday range and lower realized vol) while price remains near the centroid; larger directional moves will coincide with spikes in vol.

predictions.prediction_text: The gamma convexity is only supportive if we are above the centroid of that convexity.
predictions.condition: SPX price is above the centroid of the gamma convexity
predictions.expected_result: If SPX stays above the centroid, dealer flows and gamma effects will be net supportive and price will be biased up (higher probability of upward drift) versus if price is below.

predictions.prediction_text: If that centroid zone cannot be broken, momentum faces shorter downside gamma and increasing volatility.
predictions.condition: centroid zone cannot be broken (price fails to break below the centroid)
predictions.expected_result: SPX will exhibit increased downside gamma exposure leading to higher realized volatility and larger downside moves if price cannot penetrate the centroid zone.

predictions.prediction_text: Customer selling puts and buying calls (long skew) forces dealers into longer downside gamma, shorter upside gamma, creating left-tail risk and upside stabilization.
predictions.expected_result: Markets will show increased left-tail risk (greater probability and magnitude of downside moves) while the upside will demonstrate relative stabilization; option positioning metrics will show longer downside gamma concentrations.

predictions.prediction_text: Long speed positioning will magnetize the price upward via passage of time and vol down but leaves momentum exposed to a downside vacuum toward a 'vanna flip' point.
predictions.expected_result: SPX will tend to drift higher as IV decays, but if conditions approach the vanna flip point, price will be vulnerable to rapid downside moves (identifiable by a sharp increase in downside realized vol and IV) when that point is reached.

predictions.prediction_text: Short speed positioning can create a vacuum-up if price is above the centroid and vol accepts it, but below the centroid it magnetizes momentum downwards via vol down.
predictions.condition: price above or below the centroid of the convexity
predictions.expected_result: If SPX is above the centroid and vol falls, price may gap or accelerate upward (vacuum-up); if SPX is below the centroid and vol falls, price will be pulled downward toward the centroid (measurable directional moves consistent with centroid side).

predictions.prediction_text: Higher vol environment helps to pass through the centroid in either direction.
predictions.expected_result: In periods of elevated volatility, SPX will more frequently breach the centroid level (higher rate of centroid breaks) compared with low-vol periods.

predictions.prediction_text: If calculated SPX trigger levels get hit within the given time interval, realized vol is expected to move to the projected level.
predictions.condition: SPX hits the calculated trigger levels within the specified interval
predictions.expected_result: Realized volatility over the interval will move toward the projected vol level associated with those trigger-level hits (quantifiable change in realized vol toward projection).

predictions.prediction_text: Two SPX values can be solved where the imbalance is expected to elevate or decline towards equilibrium, producing different vol levels.
predictions.expected_result: When SPX reaches either of the two solved values, market imbalance will shift and implied/realized vol will move toward the corresponding equilibrium level (observable change in vol consistent with the predicted direction).
